definition_en: belonging separately to each person or thing mentioned
core_image: 几个人走回各自的门口，每扇门只属于一个人
scene: 会议结束后，两位经理回到了各自的办公室。After the meeting, the two managers returned to their respective offices.
sceneCN: 这里 respective 是「各自的」（第 1 个义项：分别属于先前提到的人或物）；句意：会议结束后，两位经理各自回到自己的办公室。

senses.title: Belonging to each separately
senses.definition: relating to each of the people or things already mentioned, one by one
senses.definitionCN: 逐一与已经提到的每个人或每件事相关的
senses.example: The students returned to their respective classrooms.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们回到了各自的教室。
senses.why: The word began as a relative term meaning looking back to each item, so it pairs things with their own owners.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是关系词，意为逐一回看每一项，因此把事物与各自的所有者配对。

senses.title: Separate rather than shared
senses.definition: used to stress that each item has its own separate one
senses.definitionCN: 用于强调每一项都有自己单独的一份
senses.example: Each team presented its respective plan.
senses.exampleCN: 每支队伍都展示了自己那份方案。
senses.why: If every item looks back to its own partner, the result is a set of separate belongings.
senses.whyCN: 如果每一项都对应自己的伙伴，结果就是一整套各自归属之物。

intro.en: Respective comes from Latin respectivus, looking back, from respicere, to look back at, built on re-, back, and specere, to look.
intro.cn: respective 来自拉丁语 respectivus（回看的），源于 respicere（回看），由 re-（向后）与 specere（看）构成。

items.en: Specere means to look.
items.cn: specere 意为看。

items.en: Respicere means to look back at.
items.cn: respicere 意为回看。

items.en: Respectivus means relating or looking back.
items.cn: respectivus 意为有关联的、回看的。

items.en: Respectif carries the relative sense.
items.cn: respectif 保留「各自相关」的含义。

items.en: Modern English uses respective to pair items with their own owners.
items.cn: 现代英语用 respective 把各项与各自的所有者配对。

note.en: Respective is a pairing adjective, close to respectively and to words for separate ownership.
note.cn: respective 是表示配对的形容词，与 respectively 以及表示各自所有的词相邻。

entries.definition: belonging to one person or thing

normalIntro.en: Respective points back to each item: this one to its owner, that one to its owner.
normalIntro.cn: respective 逐一回指每一项：这个对应它的主人，那个对应它的主人。

normal.en: Their respective rooms means each person's own room.
normal.cn: their respective rooms 指每个人的房间。

normal.en: Respective roles are the roles each person has.
normal.cn: respective roles 是每个人各自承担的角色。

normal.en: The adverb respectively keeps the same order.
normal.cn: 副词 respectively 保持同样的顺序。

normal.en: Respective never means respectful.
normal.cn: respective 绝不表示「恭敬的」。

normal.en: Compare separate: separate stresses division, respective stresses matching each item.
normal.cn: 对比 separate：separate 强调分开，respective 强调逐项对应。

abstract.en: Picture two people walking to two different doors.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人走向两扇不同的门。

abstract.en: Imagine two name tags placed on two different chairs.
abstract.cn: 想象两个名牌分别放在两把不同的椅子上。

abstract.en: Think of two arrows pointing to two separate boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象两个箭头分别指向两个不同的盒子。

examples.en: The two sides set out their respective views.
examples.cn: 双方各自陈述了自己的观点。

examples.en: Each member returned to their respective seat.
examples.cn: 每位成员都回到了各自的座位。

examples.en: The report compares the respective costs of the two plans.
examples.cn: 报告比较了两个方案各自的成本。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「respect + ive」——每个人都被「单独看一眼」，就是各自的；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（向后）＋ specere（看）→ respicere（回看）→ respectivus（有关的）→ 英语 respective，核心义「逐一对应、各自归属」。

sensesIntro.en: Respective first pairs each mentioned item with its own owner, and then stresses that these owners are separate.
sensesIntro.cn: respective 先把提到的每一项与自己的所有者配对，再强调这些所有者彼此分开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arrows from each item to its own owner.
core.cn: 核心意象：从每一项指向其各自所有者的箭头。

branches.en: Pairing each item with its owner is the core sense.
branches.cn: 把每一项与所有者配对是核心义项。

branches.en: Separateness is the emphasis the adjective often carries.
branches.cn: 分开是这个词常带的强调。

branches.en: Each has a separate item, and each item belongs to its own person.
branches.cn: 每人有单独的一份，每份又属于各自的人。

branches.en: The pair may be two people, two plans, or two rooms.
branches.cn: 配对对象可以是两个人、两个方案或两个房间。

branches.en: Even when the items look alike, they remain respective ones.
branches.cn: 即使物品看起来相似，它们仍是各自的东西。

intro.en: Respective belongs to the specere family of looking words, with English respect, respectful, and respectively.
intro.cn: respective 属于 specere（看）词族，英语亲属有 respect、respectful 与 respectively。

latinIntro.en: Latin specere means to look, and respicere means to look back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 specere 意为看，respicere 意为回看。

definition_zh: 分别地；各自地；按顺序地
definition_en: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned
core_image: 两组名字并排排列，箭头一一对应
scene: 小明和小红分别获得第一和第二名。Xiaoming and Xiaohong finished first and second respectively.
sceneCN: 这里 respectively 是「分别地」（第 1 个义项：按前面提到的顺序一一对应）；句意：小明和小红分别获得第一和第二名。

pos.zh: 分别地；各自地；按顺序地

senses.title: In matching order
senses.definition: used to show that two lists match item by item in the order given
senses.definitionCN: 用于表明两个列表按给出的顺序逐项对应
senses.example: Tom and Anna scored ninety and eighty respectively.
senses.exampleCN: 汤姆和安娜分别得了九十分和八十分。
senses.why: The adverb of respective marks that each number looks back to its own person in order.
senses.whyCN: respective 的副词形式标示每个数字都按顺序回指各自的人。

senses.title: Separately, each in its own way
senses.definition: separately, with each item having its own place or role
senses.definitionCN: 分开地，每项都有自己的位置或角色
senses.example: The two plants were tested respectively in shade and sun.
senses.exampleCN: 两株植物分别在阴处和阳光下接受测试。
senses.why: The pairing idea can also stress that the items are handled separately.
senses.whyCN: 配对概念也可以强调各项被分开处理。

intro.en: Respectively is respective plus -ly, from Latin respicere, to look back, so it marks a look back to each item in order.
intro.cn: respectively 是 respective 加 -ly，源自拉丁语 respicere（回看），因此标示按顺序回指每一项。

items.en: Specere means to look.
items.cn: specere 意为看。

items.en: Respicere means to look back at each.
items.cn: respicere 意为回看每一项。

items.en: Respectivus means relating to each.
items.cn: respectivus 意为与各项相关的。

items.en: The adverb respectively marks item-by-item order.
items.cn: 副词 respectively 标示逐项对应的顺序。

items.en: Modern English uses it mainly in paired lists.
items.cn: 现代英语主要在成对列表中用它。

note.en: Respectively is the adverb of respective, close to its family and to words for order and separation.
note.cn: respectively 是 respective 的副词，与自身词族以及表示顺序、分开的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Respectively is a pointing adverb: the first to the first, the second to the second.
normalIntro.cn: respectively 是「指认」副词：第一个对第一个，第二个对第二个。

normal.en: First and second respectively means in that same order.
normal.cn: first and second respectively 就是按同样的顺序。

normal.en: The adverb usually appears at the end of the paired list.
normal.cn: 这个副词通常出现在成对列表的末尾。

normal.en: Respectively never means respectfully.
normal.cn: respectively 绝不表示「恭敬地」。

normal.en: The adjective respective states the matching ownership.
normal.cn: 形容词 respective 陈述对应的归属。

normal.en: Compare separately: separately means apart, respectively means in matching order.
normal.cn: 对比 separately：separately 指分开，respectively 指按顺序对应。

abstract.en: Picture two columns of names joined by straight arrows.
abstract.cn: 想象两列名字被直线箭头一一连接。

abstract.en: Imagine two runners receiving two different medals.
abstract.cn: 想象两名跑者分别获得两枚不同的奖牌。

abstract.en: Think of two keys matched to two labeled locks.
abstract.cn: 想象两把钥匙分别对应两把有标签的锁。

examples.en: The two sisters are ten and twelve respectively.
examples.cn: 两姐妹分别是十岁和十二岁。

examples.en: The gold and silver medals went to Japan and Brazil respectively.
examples.cn: 金牌和银牌分别被日本和巴西获得。

examples.en: The boxes are marked red and blue respectively.
examples.cn: 这些盒子分别标为红色和蓝色。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「respective + ly」——一项一项「对着号」，就是分别地；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（向后）＋ specere（看）→ respicere（回看）→ respectivus → respective ＋ -ly → respectively，核心义「按顺序逐项对应」。

sensesIntro.en: Respectively first marks a one-to-one matching order, and then stresses that the matched items are handled separately.
sensesIntro.cn: respectively 先标示一对一的对应顺序，再强调被对应的事项分开处理。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lists joined by one-to-one arrows.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个列表被一对一箭头连接。

branches.en: Matching order is the main modern use.
branches.cn: 对应顺序是现代主要用法。

branches.en: Separate handling is the secondary stress.
branches.cn: 分开处理是次要强调。

branches.en: The two lists match, and each pair is dealt with apart.
branches.cn: 两个列表彼此对应，每一对又分别处理。

branches.en: The order may run forwards or backwards as long as it matches.
branches.cn: 只要对应一致，顺序可以向前或向后。

branches.en: Two results can be separately reported and still fit one sentence.
branches.cn: 两个结果可以分别报告，仍能放进同一句话。

intro.en: Respectively is a Latin looking-back adjective turned into an English adverb.
intro.cn: respectively 是拉丁语「回看」形容词转化成的英语副词。

latinIntro.en: Latin respicere means to look back, and respectivus means relative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 respicere 意为回看，respectivus 意为有关的。

items.example: Respectful belongs to the same root.

definition_en: to answer, or to react to something
core_image: 有人敲门，屋里的人立刻应声
scene: 老师提问后，她立刻举手回答。When the teacher asked, she raised her hand and responded at once.
sceneCN: 这里 responded 是 respond 的过去式，表示「回答」（第 1 个义项：用语言回应）；句意：老师提问后，她立刻举手回答。

derivatives.zh: 反应迅速的；回应积极的

senses.title: To answer in words
senses.definition: to say or write something in reply
senses.definitionCN: 用口头或书面方式作出答复
senses.example: She responded to the question with a smile.
senses.exampleCN: 她微笑着回答了这个问题。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to promise in return, so answering is a return of words.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「回以承诺」，因此回答就是言语上的回赠。

senses.title: To react to something
senses.definition: to act or change as a result of something
senses.definitionCN: 因某事物而行动或发生变化
senses.example: The patient responded well to the treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 病人对治疗反应良好。
senses.why: A reply can be an action as well as a sentence, so the word covers reactions.
senses.whyCN: 回应既可以是行动也可以是话语，因此这个词涵盖各种反应。

senses.title: To act on a need or appeal
senses.definition: to take action in answer to a request, emergency, or need
senses.definitionCN: 针对请求、紧急情况或需求采取行动
senses.example: Firefighters responded within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员几分钟内就赶到了。
senses.why: A formal reply to an appeal is carried out as an action.
senses.whyCN: 对呼吁的正式回应会落实为行动。

intro.en: Respond comes from Latin respondere, to promise in return, from re-, back, and spondere, to promise.
intro.cn: respond 来自拉丁语 respondere（回以承诺），由 re-（回）与 spondere（承诺）构成。

items.en: Spondere means to promise solemnly.
items.cn: spondere 意为郑重承诺。

items.en: Respondere means to promise or answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以承诺或答复。

items.en: Responsum is the noun for an answer.
items.cn: responsum 是表示回答的名词。

items.en: Respondre carries the answering sense.
items.cn: respondre 保留「回答」的含义。

items.en: Respond means to answer or react.
items.cn: 中古英语 respond 意为回答或反应。

items.en: Modern English extends respond to medical and emergency reactions.
items.cn: 现代英语把 respond 扩展到医疗与紧急反应。

note.en: Respond is the verb of the response family, close to answer and react words.
note.cn: respond 是 response 词族的动词，与表示回答和反应的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Respond is a return word: something comes to you, and you send an answer back.
normalIntro.cn: respond 是「回赠」词：有东西来到你面前，你把回应送回去。

normal.en: Respond to a question means answer it.
normal.cn: respond to a question 就是回答问题。

normal.en: Patients may respond well to a new drug.
normal.cn: 病人可能对新药反应良好。

normal.en: Emergency teams respond to calls for help.
normal.cn: 应急队伍响应求助呼叫。

normal.en: The noun response names the answer or reaction.
normal.cn: 名词 response 指回答或反应。

normal.en: Compare reply: reply is mostly verbal, respond also covers actions.
normal.cn: 对比 reply：reply 多为口头，respond 也涵盖行动。

abstract.en: Picture a knock at the door and a voice calling back.
abstract.cn: 想象有人敲门，屋里传出应答声。

abstract.en: Imagine a plant turning its leaves toward the sun.
abstract.cn: 想象植物把叶片转向太阳。

abstract.en: Think of a hand raised the moment a question is asked.
abstract.cn: 想象问题刚提出就有一只手举起。

examples.en: He did not respond to my email.
examples.cn: 他没有回复我的邮件。

examples.en: The engine responds quickly to the pedal.
examples.cn: 发动机对油门反应迅速。

examples.en: Volunteers responded to the call for help.
examples.cn: 志愿者们响应了求助号召。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + spond」——把话「回」过去，就是回答；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以承诺、答复）→ 英语 respond，核心义「把回应送回原处」。

sensesIntro.en: Respond starts as a verbal answer, then becomes any reaction, and finally action taken in answer to a need.
sensesIntro.cn: respond 从口头答复开始，随后指任何反应，最后指针对需求采取的行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an answer sent back to the one who called.
core.cn: 核心意象：把答复送回给发问的人。

branches.en: A verbal answer is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 口头答复是基本义项。

branches.en: Any reaction extends the answer beyond words.
branches.cn: 任何反应都让答复超越语言。

branches.en: Answering an appeal becomes action.
branches.cn: 回应呼吁落实为行动。

branches.en: A patient and a student both give back a result.
branches.cn: 病人与学生都会给出一个回馈结果。

branches.en: Reacting quickly is the first step in helping.
branches.cn: 迅速反应是提供帮助的第一步。

intro.en: Respond is a Latin promising verb, and English builds response, respondent, and responsive on it.
intro.cn: respond 是拉丁语中表示承诺的动词，英语由它构成 response、respondent 与 responsive。

latinIntro.en: Latin spondere means to promise, and respondere means to promise or answer in return.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 spondere 意为承诺，respondere 意为回以承诺或答复。

definition_zh: 回答者；受访者；被上诉人
definition_en: a person who answers questions or replies to a legal case
core_image: 一个人拿着问卷，在问题旁边写下答案
scene: 问卷回收后，研究者统计了每位受访者的答案。After collecting the questionnaires, the researcher counted each respondent's answers.
sceneCN: 这里 respondent 是「受访者」（第 1 个义项：回答调查或提问的人）；句意：问卷回收后，研究者统计了每位受访者的答案。

pos.zh: 回答者；受访者；被上诉人

senses.title: A person who answers a survey
senses.definition: someone who answers questions in a survey, interview, or study
senses.definitionCN: 在调查、访谈或研究中回答问题的人
senses.example: Most respondents said they supported the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数受访者表示支持该计划。
senses.why: The noun adds -ent, a person ending, to respond, so it names the one who answers.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词由 respond 加表示人的词尾 -ent 构成，因此指作出回答的人。

senses.title: A party in a legal case
senses.definition: the party that must answer an appeal or petition in a legal case
senses.definitionCN: 在法律案件中必须对上诉或申请作出答辩的一方
senses.example: The respondent filed a written defense.
senses.exampleCN: 被上诉人提交了书面答辩。
senses.why: Legal language keeps the old sense of one who formally answers a charge.
senses.whyCN: 法律语言保留「正式对指控作出回答者」这一古老含义。

senses.title: One who replies to a call
senses.definition: a person who replies to a message, request, or public appeal
senses.definitionCN: 对信息、请求或公开呼吁作出回应的人
senses.example: Respondents to the appeal donated food and blankets.
senses.exampleCN: 响应呼吁的人捐赠了食物和毯子。
senses.why: Any formal answer can make a person a respondent.
senses.whyCN: 任何正式回应都可以使人成为 respondent。

intro.en: Respondent comes from Latin respondens, answering, the present participle of respondere, to answer in return.
intro.cn: respondent 来自拉丁语 respondens（回答着的），是 respondere（回以答复）的现在分词。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Respondens is the answering participle.
items.cn: respondens 是表示「回答中」的分词。

items.en: Respondant names the answering party in law.
items.cn: respondant 在法律中指答辩方。

items.en: Respondent enters English as a legal term.
items.cn: respondent 作为法律术语进入英语。

items.en: Modern research adds the survey sense.
items.cn: 现代研究增加了「调查受访者」这一义项。

note.en: Respondent is a person noun from the response family, close to participant words.
note.cn: respondent 是 response 词族的人物名词，与表示参与者的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person accused in a legal case

normalIntro.en: Respondent is the person at the other end of the question: the one who responds.
normalIntro.cn: respondent 是问题另一端的人：作出回应的人。

normal.en: A survey respondent fills in the questionnaire.
normal.cn: survey respondent 填写问卷。

normal.en: The ending -ent often marks a person who acts.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ent 常标示行动的人。

normal.en: In law, the respondent answers an appeal.
normal.cn: 法律中，respondent 对上诉作出答辩。

normal.en: The plural respondents covers a whole group of answerers.
normal.cn: 复数 respondents 指一整组回答者。

normal.en: Compare participant: a participant joins, a respondent answers.
normal.cn: 对比 participant：participant 参与，respondent 回答。

abstract.en: Picture a person bent over a form with a pen.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人俯身在表格上写字。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand raised in a crowded hall.
abstract.cn: 想象拥挤大厅中举起的一只手。

abstract.en: Think of an envelope marked with a formal reply.
abstract.cn: 想象一个装着正式答辩的信封。

examples.en: Each respondent received a small gift.
examples.cn: 每位受访者都收到了一份小礼物。

examples.en: The respondent denied the claim in court.
examples.cn: 被上诉人在法庭上否认了该主张。

examples.en: Only half the respondents returned the form.
examples.cn: 只有一半的受访者交回了表格。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「respond + ent」——作出回应的那个人，就是受访者；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 respondere（回以答复）→ respondens（回答着的）→ 英语 respondent，核心义「作出回答的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Respondent first names a survey answerer, then a legal answering party, and more broadly anyone who replies.
sensesIntro.cn: respondent 先指调查回答者，再指法律答辩方，更广泛地指任何作出回应的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person writing answers beside a list of questions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人在一列问题旁写下答案。

branches.en: The survey answerer is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 调查受访者是现代主要义项。

branches.en: The legal answerer keeps the formal old sense.
branches.cn: 法律答辩方保留正式的古老含义。

branches.en: Anyone who replies to a call is a respondent.
branches.cn: 任何回应呼吁的人都是 respondent。

branches.en: A survey and a public appeal both wait for answers.
branches.cn: 调查与公开呼吁都在等待回答。

items.exampleCN: responsive 描述回应者的态度。

definition_en: an answer, or a reaction to something
core_image: 一个球被抛出去，又立刻被抛回来
scene: 她的回答简短而有力。Her response was short and powerful.
sceneCN: 这里 response 是「回答」（第 1 个义项：对提问或信息的答复）；句意：她的回答简短而有力。

senses.title: A spoken or written answer
senses.definition: something said or written in reply to a question or message
senses.definitionCN: 针对问题或信息说出的、写下的内容
senses.example: I sent a short response to her letter.
senses.exampleCN: 我给她回了一封简短的信。
senses.why: The noun comes from Latin responsum, the thing promised or said back.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词来自拉丁语 responsum，即被回赠或回说之物。

senses.title: A physical or emotional reaction
senses.definition: a reaction of the body, mind, or system to something
senses.definitionCN: 身体、心理或系统对某事物的反应
senses.example: The medicine produced a strong response.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药产生了强烈的反应。
senses.why: A reply need not be verbal; any return effect is a response.
senses.whyCN: 回应不必是语言的；任何回馈效果都是 response。

senses.title: An organized reply to an emergency
senses.definition: the action taken by a group in answer to an emergency or appeal
senses.definitionCN: 群体针对紧急情况或呼吁采取的行动
senses.example: The flood response lasted three weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 这次洪灾应急响应持续了三周。
senses.why: An organized answer to danger is a large-scale extension of the reply idea.
senses.whyCN: 对危险的集体回应，是「答复」概念的大规模延伸。

intro.en: Response comes from Latin responsum, an answer, from respondere, to answer in return.
intro.cn: response 来自拉丁语 responsum（回答），源于 respondere（回以答复）。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Responsum means an answer.
items.cn: responsum 意为回答。

items.en: Response carries the noun into French.
items.cn: response 把这个名词带入法语。

items.en: Response names an answer or reaction.
items.cn: 中古英语 response 指回答或反应。

items.en: Modern English adds medical and emergency responses.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了医疗与应急响应。

note.en: Response is the noun of the respond family, close to answer and reaction words.
note.cn: response 是 respond 词族的名词，与表示回答和反应的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Response is the ball thrown back: question goes out, answer comes home.
normalIntro.cn: response 是被抛回的球：问题出去，答案回来。

normal.en: In response to means as an answer to.
normal.cn: in response to 表示作为对……的回答。

normal.en: A quick response is a fast answer.
normal.cn: quick response 是迅速的答复。

normal.en: The body can have a strong response to medicine.
normal.cn: 身体可能对药物产生强烈反应。

normal.en: Emergency response teams act during disasters.
normal.cn: emergency response 队伍在灾害中行动。

normal.en: Compare reaction: reaction is broader and less formal.
normal.cn: 对比 reaction：reaction 范围更广、更不正式。

abstract.en: Picture a ball bouncing straight back to the thrower.
abstract.cn: 想象球直接弹回投掷者手中。

abstract.en: Imagine a light switching on the moment a button is pressed.
abstract.cn: 想象按下按钮的瞬间灯亮起。

abstract.en: Think of a letter answered the same day it arrives.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信到达当天就得到回复。

examples.cn: 我们的呼叫没有得到任何回应。

examples.en: The audience gave the singer a warm response.
examples.cn: 观众给了歌手热烈的回应。

examples.en: The survey had a high response rate.
examples.cn: 这次调查的回应率很高。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以答复）→ responsum（回答）→ 英语 response，核心义「送回的回答或反应」。

sensesIntro.en: Response begins as a verbal answer, extends to any physical or emotional reaction, and finally to organized emergency action.
sensesIntro.cn: response 从口头回答开始，扩展到任何生理或情绪反应，最后指有组织的应急行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an answer returning to the source of the call.
core.cn: 核心意象：答复返回呼叫的源头。

branches.en: The verbal answer is the core sense.
branches.cn: 口头回答是核心义项。

branches.en: Any reaction extends the answer beyond language.
branches.cn: 任何反应都让回答超越语言。

branches.en: Organized emergency action is the public-scale sense.
branches.cn: 有组织的应急行动是公共规模义项。

branches.en: A patient and a reader both give back something.
branches.cn: 病人与读者都会给出回馈。

branches.en: Reacting to a flood becomes a coordinated response.
branches.cn: 对洪灾的反应发展成协调一致的响应。

intro.en: Response is a Latin answer noun, and English builds respond, respondent, and responsive around the same root.
intro.cn: response 是拉丁语「回答」名词，英语围绕同一词根构成 respond、respondent 与 responsive。

latinIntro.en: Latin spondere means to promise, and responsum means an answer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 spondere 意为承诺，responsum 意为回答。

items.exampleCN: responsive 描述随时回应的状态。

definition_en: a duty to deal with something, or the state of being accountable
core_image: 一个人双手稳稳托着一件必须照看的东西
scene: 照顾年迈的父母是每个子女的责任。Caring for elderly parents is the responsibility of every child.
sceneCN: 这里 responsibility 是「责任」（第 1 个义项：应当承担并处理的事情）；句意：照顾年迈的父母是每个子女的责任。

senses.title: A duty to deal with something
senses.definition: a duty to take care of something or to do a job
senses.definitionCN: 照看某事物或完成某项工作的义务
senses.example: Feeding the animals is my responsibility.
senses.exampleCN: 喂养动物是我的责任。
senses.why: The noun is formed from responsible, which comes from a verb meaning to answer in return, so a duty is something you must answer for.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词由 responsible 构成，而 responsible 源于「回以答复」的动词，因此责任就是你必须作出交代的事。

senses.title: Accountability for a result
senses.definition: the state of being the one who must explain or be blamed for something
senses.definitionCN: 必须为某事作出解释或承担过失的状态
senses.example: The manager accepted responsibility for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 经理承担了延误的责任。
senses.why: To answer for an outcome is to be accountable for it.
senses.whyCN: 对结果作出交代，就是对结果负责。

senses.title: A person or thing in one's care
senses.definition: a person or thing that one must look after
senses.definitionCN: 必须由某人照管的人或事物
senses.example: The children are her responsibility while their parents are away.
senses.exampleCN: 父母不在时，孩子们由她照管。
senses.why: A duty can be embodied in the very person or thing you must care for.
senses.whyCN: 责任可以具体化为你必须照管的某个人或某件事。

intro.en: Responsibility is responsible plus -ity, from Latin respondere, to answer in return, so it names the state of having to answer.
intro.cn: responsibility 是 responsible 加 -ity，源自拉丁语 respondere（回以答复），指必须作出交代的状态。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Responsum means an answer.
items.cn: responsum 意为回答。

items.en: Responsible means answerable for something.
items.cn: 英语 responsible 意为对某事负责。

items.en: The suffix -ity forms responsibility.
items.cn: 词尾 -ity 构成 responsibility。

items.en: Modern English uses responsibility for duties and for accountability.
items.cn: 现代英语用 responsibility 指职责与问责。

note.en: Responsibility is the state noun of responsible, close to duty and accountability words.
note.cn: responsibility 是 responsible 的状态名词，与表示义务和问责的词相邻。

entries.definition: the duty to explain one's actions

normalIntro.en: Responsibility is what you must answer for: the duty is a question waiting for your reply.
normalIntro.cn: responsibility 是你必须作出交代的事：责任就是一个等着你回答的问题。

normal.en: Take responsibility means admit that it is your job.
normal.cn: take responsibility 表示承认这是你的责任。

normal.en: A sense of responsibility is the feeling that you must act.
normal.cn: sense of responsibility 是觉得自己必须行动的意识。

normal.en: Social responsibility means caring about others.
normal.cn: social responsibility 指关心他人。

normal.en: The adjective responsible means having the duty.
normal.cn: 形容词 responsible 意为负有责任。

normal.en: Compare duty: duty is a task, responsibility also includes being accountable.
normal.cn: 对比 duty：duty 是任务，responsibility 还包含问责。

abstract.en: Picture two hands holding a fragile bowl steady.
abstract.cn: 想象双手稳稳托住一只易碎的碗。

abstract.en: Imagine a key kept safe because it opens every door.
abstract.cn: 想象一把因能打开所有门而被小心保管的钥匙。

abstract.en: Think of a lighthouse keeper who never leaves the lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一位从不离开灯火的灯塔看守人。

examples.en: She took full responsibility for the mistake.
examples.cn: 她为这个错误承担了全部责任。

examples.en: Teaching children is a serious responsibility.
examples.cn: 教育孩子是一项重大的责任。

examples.en: The job comes with many responsibilities.
examples.cn: 这份工作伴随着许多职责。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「response + ibility」——必须「回应」的事，就是责任；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以答复）→ responsible（负责的）＋ -ity → responsibility，核心义「必须作出交代的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Responsibility first names a duty, then the accountability for a result, and finally the very person or thing one must care for.
sensesIntro.cn: responsibility 先指职责，再指对结果的问责，最后指必须照管的人或事本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a duty held in both hands like a fragile bowl.
core.cn: 核心意象：像端着一只易碎的碗那样托着责任。

branches.en: A duty is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 职责是日常义项。

branches.en: Accountability adds the answering-for sense.
branches.cn: 问责增加了「作出交代」的含义。

branches.en: The cared-for person or thing embodies the duty.
branches.cn: 被照管的人或事体现了责任。

branches.en: A duty that goes wrong brings accountability.
branches.cn: 职责出错时就会带来问责。

branches.en: Looking after a child is both a duty and a trust.
branches.cn: 照看孩子既是职责，也是信任。

intro.en: Responsibility stacks -ity on responsible, which itself comes from a Latin answering verb.
intro.cn: responsibility 在 responsible 上叠加 -ity，而 responsible 源自拉丁语「答复」动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin respondere means to answer in return, built on spondere, to promise.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 respondere 意为回以答复，建立在 spondere（承诺）之上。

definition_zh: 负责的；有责任的；可靠的
definition_en: having a duty, being the cause, or being reliable
core_image: 一个人手里握着一串钥匙，要对每扇门负责
scene: 值夜班的护士负责检查每一间病房。The nurse on night duty is responsible for checking every ward.
sceneCN: 这里 responsible 是「负责的」（第 1 个义项：负有职责、须对某事负责）；句意：值夜班的护士负责检查每一间病房。

pos.zh: 负责的；有责任的；可靠的

senses.title: Having a duty or being in charge
senses.definition: having the job of looking after something or someone
senses.definitionCN: 负有照看某物或某人的职责
senses.example: She is responsible for the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她负责整个团队。
senses.why: The word comes from a Latin verb meaning to answer in return, so the responsible person is the one who must answer.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自意为「回以答复」的拉丁动词，因此负责的人就是必须作出交代的人。

senses.title: Being the cause of something
senses.definition: being the cause of an event, especially a bad one
senses.definitionCN: 是某事件的原因，尤指坏事件
senses.example: Heavy rain was responsible for the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 大雨是这场洪水的原因。
senses.why: The one who must answer for an event is often the one who caused it.
senses.whyCN: 必须为事件作出交代的人，往往就是造成事件的人。

senses.title: Reliable and sensible
senses.definition: able to be trusted to act sensibly and carefully
senses.definitionCN: 可以被信任，能明智谨慎地行事
senses.example: We need a responsible driver for the night trip.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间出行我们需要一位可靠的司机。
senses.why: A person who answers for their actions is likely to act carefully.
senses.whyCN: 能为自己的行为负责的人，往往会谨慎行事。

senses.title: Accountable to someone
senses.definition: required to report to a person or authority
senses.definitionCN: 须向某人或某机构汇报的
senses.example: The committee is responsible to the whole school.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会对全校负责。
senses.why: Answering in return also means answering to a higher authority.
senses.whyCN: 回以答复也意味着向更高权威作出交代。

definition_en: reacting quickly or positively to something
core_image: 手一碰屏幕，画面立刻亮起变化

pos.zh: 反应迅速的；回应积极的；响应灵敏的

senses.title: Reacting quickly
senses.definition: reacting quickly and readily to something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物迅速而乐意地作出反应
senses.example: The staff are friendly and responsive.
senses.exampleCN: 员工友好且反应迅速。
senses.why: The adjective adds -ive to response, so it describes a readiness to answer.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词由 response 加 -ive 构成，描述随时准备回应的状态。

senses.title: Reacting well to treatment or needs
senses.titleCN: 反应良好的；回应需求的
senses.definition: showing a good reaction to medicine, care, or a request
senses.definitionCN: 对药物、照护或请求表现出良好反应
senses.example: The tumor was responsive to the new drug.
senses.exampleCN: 这个肿瘤对新药有良好反应。
senses.why: A good answer to treatment is a positive response.
senses.whyCN: 对治疗的良好答复就是积极反应。

senses.title: Reacting to input in technology
senses.definition: designed to change or react according to input or screen size

senses.example: The website has a responsive layout for phones.

senses.why: A system that answers every input is literally responsive.

items.en: Modern English adds the technology sense of responsive design.

abstract.en: Think of a plant closing its leaves at a touch.
